messages:
jess: Heads-up — on last private rollout to customer ACME we saw the canary never reached 5% for ~10m due to control-plane propagation lag across their air-gapped relay. Observability shows config applied in control plane but not delivered to edge; requests kept hitting old model.
kevin: ugh. was that the new 'declarative rollout' API? did the control-plane ack and then try push? any error logs from the relay?
sara: relay logs showed handshake + version mismatch errors, then exponential backoff. It accepted the new rollout manifest but failed on the grpc streaming because the relay is behind an old agent (v1.9.0) — needs 1.11.0 for chunked/delta updates.
amal: is that why the console showed 'Applied' but devices still 'Pending'? we need a clearer propagation status in UI. 'Applied -> Delivered -> Active' maybe.
jess: exactly. UX should show per-target propagation state + ETA. Right now it's ambiguous whether 'Applied' == fully rolled out. Also we should gate traffic splits until at least one relay reports 'Delivered'.
kevin: engineer-discussion: should the runtime (router) enforce a guard that refuses >X% traffic to a variant unless N% of targets report delivered? That would keep canary semantics consistent across private.
sara: yes. proposal: require (delivered_targets / total_targets) >= 0.5 before moving from 1% -> 5% and >=0.9 before >25%. Config knobs in rollout manifest:
```
{
  "required_delivery_fraction": {"step1": 0.5, "step2": 0.9},
  "max_step_increment": 4
}
```
kevin: implementation detail: router needs to evaluate on control-plane metrics only or per-relay RT telemetry? For air-gapped relays the control plane only knows when the relay acked; but agent might ack without successfully pulling model if it cached old chunks.
amal: we have a 'delivery_confirm' event emitted by the agent after chunk verification. if agent version supports it. Otherwise control-plane should mark as 'unknown' and we shouldn't count unknown as delivered.
jess: fallback strategy for old agents: conservative default — treat unknown as not delivered, but allow customer opt-in to 'best_effort_delivery=true' so they can proceed faster.
sara: also need console telemetry: per-rollout timeline, per-target last_seen, last_error, and a small 'expected finish' estimate based on throughput and backoff timings.
kevin: for API surface, debating between two options:
1) blocking apply: POST /rollouts -> returns when rollout state 'Applied' AND delivered fraction met (long poll)
2) async apply (current): returns 202 with rollout id; add endpoint /rollouts/:id/wait?until=delivered_fraction=0.5
I prefer #2 to avoid long-hanging requests.
amal: #2 is better. but we should add a convenience param `wait_until=delivered:0.5,timeout:300s` on create for SDKs.
jess: agreed. add an explicit 'propagation_timeline' event stream in web UI and SDKs.
deploy-bot: Deployment 1782345678: created rollout 0xabc; initial 1% pushed to 2 targets.
deploy-bot: Relay 10.0.3.5 acked manifest
deploy-bot: Relay 10.0.3.6 failed to verify chunks (checksum mismatch)
kevin: action items: (1) add delivered_fraction guard into router (kevin), (2) console: propagation states per-relay + ETA (sara), (3) rollback default on unknown agents (amal), (4) SDK wait_until param + docs (jess). I'll open PRs. :thumbsup:
jess: thanks — i'll coordinate with support to reach out to that customer about agent upgrade and to enable conservative default on their account.
